subject: general
question:
**In the given sentence, identify the segment which contains a grammatical error.**

I am getting used to drive on the busy roads of the crowded city.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **drive on**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **'drive' **with **'driving'** to make the sentence correct.
 
• **"Used to"** is a phrasal verb which means to develop the habit of.
 
• **Gerunds (verb 1 + ing) **are always used with phrasal verbs that end in prepositions.
 
• **Example - **
 
 
• *I am looking forward to meeting you.*
 
• *The doctor went around the hospital visiting his patients.*
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, '**driving**' should be used in the given sentence.

Hence the correct answer is **option 2** which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:** *I am getting used to **driving on __**the busy roads of the crowded city.*
